request.query: power of natural floor dominates power from strict logarithmic lower bound

items.name: Nat.pow_le_of_le_log
items.type: ∀ {b x y : ℕ}, y ≠ 0 → x ≤ Nat.log b y → b ^ x ≤ y

items.name: Nat.le_pow_iff_clog_le
items.type: ∀ {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ {x y : ℕ}, x ≤ b ^ y ↔ Nat.clog b x ≤ y

items.name: Nat.clog_le_iff_le_pow
items.type: ∀ {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ {x y : ℕ}, Nat.clog b x ≤ y ↔ x ≤ b ^ y

items.name: Nat.pow_le_iff_le_log
items.type: ∀ {b : ℕ}, 1 < b → ∀ {x y : ℕ}, y ≠ 0 → (b ^ x ≤ y ↔ x ≤ Nat.log b y)

items.name: Nat.lt_pow_of_log_lt
items.type: ∀ {b x y : ℕ}, 1 < b → Nat.log b y < x → y < b ^ x
